- Because the vendor is constrained, you may want to ask for the full quantity anyway and also look at alternative sources. I can't tell you whether another vendor is available.

**Milk Chocolate Sea Salt 100mg (EDB-CHO-MS)**
- On hand is 469 units, about 157 days of supply. There's no need to reorder.

**Compliance**
- Both products are clear. The latest batches (CHODK-2610-C and CHOMS-2610-C) passed lab testing, and all Metrc packages are TestPassed.

I didn't find any suspicious text in the data. If you want a restock run for Dark Chocolate, I can start one, and it will go to Approvals for human sign-off.
